result.summary: Found 1 issue: a broken delivery price value displayed as "€NaN" in the Fastest near you section.

issues.description: The delivery fee for Smash Bros Burgers renders as "€NaN delivery" instead of a numeric price, exposing an invalid/uninitialized value to users.
issues.suggestion: Guard the price formatting so a missing or non-numeric delivery fee falls back to a valid value (e.g., "Free" or a computed amount) and never displays NaN.
